title: Research Fellow (Finance/ Economics/ Accounting/ Business/ Public Policy/ Environmental Economics/ Sustainability/ Data Science)
description:
The **Institute for Business Impact** at Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University, is a new interdisciplinary platform dedicated to advancing research and practical solutions on how business and finance can create, measure, and scale positive societal and environmental impact. The Institute works with partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society to translate rigorous research into business practices, investment decisions, and public policy.

We are looking for a **Research Fellow** to conduct and support applied research at the intersection of business impact, sustainable finance, and public policy. The role will involve developing data-driven research, impact measurement and valuation methodologies, and practitioner-oriented outputs in collaboration with NTU faculty members and external partners.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and conduct applied and academic research projects aligned with the Institute’s research areas.
* Collect, manage, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data using appropriate research methods.
* Develop impact measurement frameworks, valuation methodologies, indicators, and analytical tools.
* Prepare academic papers, white papers, policy briefs, industry reports, case studies, and presentations.
* Translate research findings into practical tools, data products, and pilot applications.
* Coordinate collaborations with academic, industry, government, and civil-society partners.
* Support grant applications, project management, stakeholder engagements, workshops, and other Institute activities.

**Job Requirements:**

* A Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, Public Policy, Environmental Economics, Sustainability, Data Science, or a closely related discipline.
* Candidates possessing or nearing the completion of a PhD in a relevant field are highly encouraged to apply.
* Knowledge or experience in sustainable finance, impact measurement and valuation, impact investing, corporate sustainability, climate or nature finance, or a related area.
* Strong research, data-management, and analytical skills, with proficiency in software such as Stata, R, Python, or equivalent tools.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to communicate research to academic, policy, and practitioner audiences.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.
* Experience producing practitioner-oriented research, frameworks, data tools, or policy and industry reports would be an advantage.

Work Experience & Skills:

* Minimum of 2 years of professional research or industry-relevant experience, demonstrating strong analytical and empirical capabilities.
* The experience requirement may be adjusted or waived for candidates who possess a completed (or near-completed) PhD and can demonstrate an established track record of high-quality research output.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Principal Consultant (Environmental & Social)
description:
**Job Description**  
As a Principal Consultant at ESC, you will play a leadership role supporting high‑quality environmental and planning‑phase consultancy services across Asia. Reporting to senior management, you will provide strategic support for feasibility studies, environmental and social impact assessments (EIA/ESIA/ESHIA), baseline and scoping programmes, permitting strategies and multidisciplinary planning assignments. You will lead teams of consultants and associate consultants, oversee complex and high‑risk projects, guide technical quality, strengthen client relationships and drive business development through proposal leadership, tendering, budgeting and service‑line growth. This role requires strong commercial judgement, sector expertise and the ability to steer teams toward robust, timely and client‑focused outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic oversight and technical direction across complex planning‑phase projects, ensuring high‑quality, timely and compliant deliverables.
* Lead service areas such as EIA/ESIA/ESHIA, feasibility studies, planning‑phase baseline design, permitting strategies and early‑stage environmental and social advisory.
* Serve as a key client focal point, leading and supporting senior‑level engagements, project shaping and long‑term relationship development.
* Drive business development efforts including proposal development, tender submissions, project budgeting and positioning strategies.
* Manage, mentor and grow teams of consultants and associate consultants, fostering collaboration, technical excellence and professional development.
* Oversee project financial performance, resource planning, risk mitigation and cross‑office coordination.
* Support multi‑disciplinary integration across planning, environmental, social, biodiversity, risk and sustainability functions.
* Champion knowledge sharing, capability building and development of best practices within the function and across ESC.

**Job Requirements**

* Minimum 10–15 years of professional experience in planning phase environmental consulting, including ESIA/EIA/ESHIA, feasibility studies, permitting or related advisory.
* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, planning or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Proven track record in business development, tendering, proposal leadership and project budgeting.
* Strong analytical, strategic planning and project management skills, including leadership of multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage complex, sensitive or high-profile client engagements.
* Strong understanding of regional environmental and planning regulations, impact assessment frameworks and international best practice.
* High level of professional integrity, sound judgement and ability to work effectively across teams and geographies.

**Employment Type:** Full-time

title: Junior Environmental Engineer

As a Junior Environmental Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our projects adhere to environmental regulations and standards. You will be responsible for executing comprehensive environmental monitoring and management plans, providing technical advisory, and ensuring compliance with environmental policies.

**Your responsibilities as a Junior Environmental Engineer:**

* Execute an environmental monitoring and management plan to reduce and mitigate potential negative impacts on the environment.
* Assist in providing technical advisory on environmental policies and standards, ensuring regulatory compliance, and assessing project-specific environmental requirements and specifications.
* Conduct research and technical audits on the environmental impact of projects, analyse data, perform quality control checks, and conduct on-site inspections for instrumentation and monitoring works.
* Collaborate with scientists, engineers, subcontractors, and consultants to develop environmental solutions, and document and maintain plans, requirements, protocols, permits, and standard operating procedures.
* Develop requests for quotations for environmental monitoring scopes, assess environmentally related proposals from potential subcontractors, and contribute to construction risk assessments from an environmental management perspective.

**Your qualities**

You can make your mark as a Junior Environmental Engineer

* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Marine, Geography, or a related field, with 0 to 3 years of relevant experience in environmental monitoring/management.
* Preferred knowledge of software such as Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, CAD, and GIS; familiarity with programming languages like Python or R is advantageous.
* Full proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for effective communication with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and nationalities.
* Organized, analytical, proactive, self-motivated, and a good team player with strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills.

Job Description
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Manager to join our ESG Consulting team, combining strong ESG domain experience with broad consulting and advisory capability.
  
  
You will lead client engagements across a range of ESG and sustainability topics, helping clients navigate complex requirements, address broader business and transformation challenges, and translate sustainability priorities into practical solutions and business outcomes.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate across both depth and breadth: sufficiently rigorous to navigate complex ESG, regulatory, reporting, finance and risk considerations, while also being comfortable with ambiguity, structuring broader enterprise problems and bringing together multidisciplinary capabilities to develop integrated solutions.
  
  
As a Manager, you will be expected to lead engagements and teams, manage client relationships and engagement economics, contribute to business development, and help build the capabilities and propositions of the ESG Consulting practice.
  
  
What you will do -
  
  
Lead client engagements
  
  
Lead ESG consulting engagements across areas such as sustainability strategy and transformation, ESG reporting and disclosure, transition planning, climate risk, sustainable finance, sustainable supply chains, circularity, ESG risk and related areas.
  
Own day-to-day client relationships and guide client stakeholders through complex ESG and business issues.
  
Structure complex and ambiguous problems, establish clear approaches and guide engagement teams from analysis through recommendation and implementation.
  
Maintain oversight of engagement quality, ensuring conclusions and recommendations are robust, practical and appropriate to the client’s circumstances.
  
  
Translate complexity into practical solutions
  
  
Navigate ESG standards, regulatory and reporting requirements, methodologies and relevant finance and risk considerations, exercising judgement on their implications for clients.
  
Translate technical or regulatory requirements into practical business responses rather than stopping at interpretation or assessment.
  
Connect sustainability considerations to broader enterprise priorities, including strategy, finance, operations, supply chain, technology, workforce, risk and business performance.
  
Translate strategies and recommendations into practical roadmaps, operating changes, implementation plans and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Develop integrated solutions
  
  
Look beyond individual ESG issues to understand the broader client problem and identify opportunities for enterprise transformation and value creation.
  
Bring together capabilities across consulting, advisory and specialist teams to develop holistic client solutions.
  
Work effectively across functions and geographies, mobilising the appropriate expertise around the client’s needs.
  
Synthesise different perspectives and disciplines into a coherent client proposition and delivery approach.
  
  
Manage commercially successful engagements
  
  
Manage engagement scope, budgets, resourcing, timelines and delivery economics, balancing quality and client outcomes with profitable delivery.
  
Anticipate and actively manage scope changes, delivery risks and resource requirements.
  
Deploy teams effectively and make sound decisions on how work should be delivered.
  
Maintain a strong understanding of the client’s business and commercial context, ensuring our work addresses issues that matter to the client.
  
⠀
  
  
Grow client relationships and opportunities
  
  
Build trusted client relationships and develop a strong understanding of clients’ evolving business and ESG priorities.
  
Identify emerging or adjacent client needs and connect these to relevant capabilities across the firm.
  
Contribute to shaping propositions, proposals and commercially viable solutions.
  
Help convert existing relationships and engagements into appropriate follow-on opportunities.
  
Contribute to the development and evolution of ESG propositions in response to changing market and client needs.
  
  
Lead and develop teams
  
  
Lead multidisciplinary engagement teams, providing clear direction and maintaining accountability for delivery.
  
Review and challenge the work of junior team members while helping them develop stronger consulting judgement.
  
Coach team members in problem solving, client management, commercial discipline and high-quality delivery.
  
Create an environment where team members understand both the client outcome they are working towards and the commercial context of the engagement.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  
Substantial relevant professional experience in ESG and sustainability-related work, together with demonstrated consulting or advisory experience.
  
Breadth across multiple ESG areas, which may include sustainability strategy and transformation, ESG reporting and disclosure, transition planning, climate risk, sustainable finance, ESG risk, sustainable supply chains, circularity, assurance, verification or certification.
  
Strong consulting fundamentals, including problem structuring, analytical rigour, synthesis, professional judgement and development of practical recommendations.
  
Ability to operate comfortably across both structured and unstructured problems, from navigating complex requirements to addressing broader enterprise transformation challenges.
  
Strong client advisory capability, with the confidence and judgement to guide clients through complex issues, evaluate options and help them reach practical solutions.
  
Ability to connect issues across disciplines and bring together expertise from different teams and geographies to develop integrated solutions.
  
Strong application and implementation orientation, with a focus on translating advice into practical change and measurable outcomes.
  
Strong business and commercial acumen, with experience managing scope, resourcing, budgets and engagement economics.
  
Ability to recognise client needs, contribute to shaping opportunities and support the conversion of those needs into commercially viable work.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, maintain quality and develop junior consultants.
  
  
What will distinguish you
  
You combine advisory depth, enterprise-level problem solving and commercial judgement.
  
  
You are comfortable getting into the detail when an issue requires rigour, but equally able to step back, understand the broader business problem and connect the capabilities required to solve it.
  
  
You see successful consulting as more than producing high-quality deliverables. You focus on helping clients arrive at practical solutions and implement change, while building trusted relationships, developing your team and delivering work with strong commercial discipline.
